player_prompt.intro:
Uyini Mfiri {player_id} eka Connect Four.
Simbolo ya diski yakwe: {symbol}.
Bhoja ya gema i na {num_rows} marhavi na {num_cols} kolomisi.
Mafiri ma tanda vukati byo bya diski yakwe eka yin'wani ya kolomisi (0 ku fika {end_col}).
Loyi a sungula ku ringanisa (diski yakwe yin'wana) min'wani ina wona, vukati, kumbe kwalomuza, u nyika.
Eka vukati byakwe, andza nambari ya kolomisi eka mihlava ku endla nguvo yakwe.
Ku ringana na: '[col 4]' kumbe '[col 1]'.

board.board_notvisible_state: Vatlangi a va swi koti ku vona bodo ya ntlango.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mfiri {player_id}, Mfumo wa nguvo leri ringanyetiwa. Ku na mfumo lowu fanaka: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Mfiri {player_id}, Nguvo leri ringanyetiwa. Kolomisi {col} i phele kwala.
invalid_move.already_full: Mfiri {player_id}, Nguvo leri ringanyetiwa. Kolomisi {col} i manene.

action.dropped_disk: Mfiri {player_id} u hoxile diski yakwe ({player_symbol}) eka kolomisi {col}.

outcome.win: Mutlangi {player_id} u hlula hi ku hlanganisa mune!
outcome.draw: Ntlangu wu hele hi ku nga ha vi na munhu la tlangaka.
